scope: Bounded independent comparison of the 32 core roads whose centerline control count changed between old model be04 and new World 939084. No source/runtime writes. No global geometry, vehicle capacity, junction cap, headroom or native acceptance.

methods.lineage: Bracket each inserted new centerpoint between consecutively retained exact old vertices. Project to that specific old segment and require monotonically increasing parameters, residual below 1e-8 m, and all old vertices retained exactly in order. Compare every new L/R point to old L/R linear interpolation at its bracketed fraction.
methods.union: For each supplied ribbon span use literal triangles [R0,R1,L1] and [R0,L1,L0], unary union in XZ. Differences are floating-point GEOS polygon operations; no precision snapping or simplification.
methods.hausdorff: GEOS discrete Hausdorff distance on original polygon boundary vertices; not asserted to be exact continuous Hausdorff.
methods.metadata: Compare all road fields except pts/elev for these 32 roads. Independently measure each new cross-section length against nominal width w. Lane count and nominal width preservation are metadata conclusions, not actual vehicle capacity acceptance.

findings.reviewRequired: 27 roads have changed physical strip support. Their old physical support, clearance or capacity acceptance cannot automatically transfer. Use the new exact footprints for subsequent finite geometry and vehicle checks.
findings.separateCaps: Supplied L/R arrays define strip span triangles. Separate junction caps, fans and joins were not provided or compared; no cap equality is claimed.
findings.projectedSectionDiagnostic: The union receipt contains a maximum 2.017118853 m projected section-width difference. This depends on cross-section orientation and is not treated as proof of usable clear width or lane capacity loss.
findings.nominalWidth: All new cross-section lengths equal unchanged nominal road width w within 2.0694557179012918e-12 m. All lane counts are unchanged.

openGates: Review the 27 changed strip unions against exact railway, road, building and surface envelopes.
Rebuild and verify actual junction cap/fan/strip surfaces and owner closure from the fresh joint input.
Independent finite headroom, actual triangle grade, wheel/body contact and native driving remain open.
acceptanceBoundary: Lineage and metadata checks pass. Footprint geometry is measurably different. This receipt grants no global geometry, actual vehicle capacity, runtime or release approval.
